text: This is a story about a recommendation that was written down and not made a rule.
provenance: This is a story about a recommendation that was written down and not made a rule.

text: In two thousand and eleven, Texas got weather like this. Power plants tripped offline. Rolling blackouts were ordered.
provenance: In two thousand and eleven, Texas got weather like this.

text: They produced a report, and the report made a recommendation. It recommended the development of winterization standards.
provenance: They produced a report, and the report made a recommendation.
It recommended the development of winterization standards.

text: A recommendation is a document. Nobody audits a recommendation. Nobody is penalised for not following one. A standard is a rule with a mechanism behind it.
provenance: Nobody is penalised for not following one.
A standard is a rule with a mechanism behind it.

text: The standards organisation ultimately declined to act on it. Nobody refused in a room with a table.

text: Ten years passed between the report and the storm. When February twenty twenty-one arrived, generating units failed from freezing above their own stated ambient design temperature.

text: Not below the temperature the unit was built to survive. Above it. The machines were failing in weather they were rated for.

text: And the rules themselves were adopted on the thirtieth of August, twenty twenty-two. Eleven years, five months and nineteen days after the report that recommended them.
